name: How long does a custom-built deck last?
description: Deck lifespan varies by material and maintenance, with wood lasting 15-20 years and composite 25-30+ years.

mainEntity.name: How long does a custom-built deck last?

acceptedAnswer.text: The lifespan of a custom-built deck largely depends on the materials used, the quality of construction, and how well it is maintained. A well-built deck using pressure-treated lumber might last 15-20 years, while a composite deck can last 25-30 years or more with minimal maintenance. Regular cleaning, sealing (for wood), and prompt repairs can significantly extend its durability. Your choice of material presents a practical tradeoff between initial cost, expected lifespan, and ongoing maintenance commitment.
